_comment: Seed file for `distill site-batch` / `distill ramp-up configs/example_seeds.json`. Copy this file, rename it (e.g. configs/myvendor_seeds.json — gitignored), and replace the URLs below with pages you actually want to ingest. The seeds are the exact URLs distill will capture and analyze in --seed-only mode; with shallow crawl enabled, distill will follow links one hop deep inside the same section.
